landing.title: Family Wellness Platform
landing.subtitle: One app your whole family opens.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.body: This app stores what you log — workouts, meals, water, sleep — and any health conditions you choose to share, so it can build a plan that fits you. You can export or delete this data at any time.
consent.healthDataLabel: I agree to the app storing my health data
consent.guestBody: You're exploring as a guest. Everything you log is saved, and you can add an email later to keep it.

home.title: You're set up
home.noFamily: You're not in a family yet.
home.guestNote: You're exploring as a guest. Add an email later to keep what you log.
home.todayNoProfile: Tell us a little about you and we'll build a plan that fits.
home.todayPlanReady: Your profile is saved. Your workout plan is ready when you are.

onboarding.title: Build your plan
onboarding.disclaimer: This isn't medical advice. We use this to leave out exercises that aren't right for you — if you're unsure about something, ask your doctor.

labels.goal: What matters most to you right now?
labels.level: How active are you at the moment?
labels.equipment: What do you have to train with?

plan.title: Your plan
plan.empty: You don't have a plan yet. Build one from your profile — it takes a second.
plan.whyTitle: Why this plan looks like this
plan.whyBody: We left out anything that isn't right for what you told us:
plan.disclaimer: This isn't medical advice. If anything hurts, stop — and check with your doctor if you're unsure.
plan.noProfile: Tell us about yourself first and we'll build your plan.
plan.regenerateHint: Your plan comes from your details, so change what's different and we'll build a new one.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Today's plan is available; anything new will load when you reconnect.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something in that form wasn't right. Please check and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.REGISTRATION_REQUIRED: One more step before you can continue.
errors.OTP_REQUEST_FAILED: We couldn't send that code. Please check the number or email and try again.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't reach the server. Please try again in a moment.
errors.GUEST_SIGNIN_FAILED: We couldn't start a guest session. Please try again in a moment.
errors.PROFILE_SAVE_FAILED: We couldn't save your answers. They're still here — please try again.
errors.PROFILE_REQUIRED: We need a few details about you before we can build a plan.
errors.PLAN_GENERATE_FAILED: We couldn't build your plan. Please try again in a moment.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.ALREADY_IN_FAMILY: You're already in a family. Leave that one first.
errors.INVITE_EXPIRED: That code doesn't work any more. Ask for a fresh one.
errors.NOT_IN_FAMILY: You need to be in a family to do that.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ROLE: Your role in the family doesn't allow that.
errors.FAMILY_ACTION_FAILED: That didn't work. Please try again in a moment.
errors.TRACKING_FAILED: We couldn't save that. Please try again in a moment.
errors.MEAL_SUGGEST_FAILED: We couldn't put suggestions together. Please try again in a moment.
errors.SIGN_OUT_FAILED: We couldn't sign you out. Please try again in a moment.

family.title: Your family
family.noFamilyBody: You're not in a family yet. Start one and invite the people you live with, or join with a code someone gave you.
family.joinHint: Ask whoever set it up for a code. It's 10 characters and works once.
family.inviteRoleLabel: What should they be able to do?
family.inviteOnce: It works once, and expires in 7 days. We won't show it again.

roles.adult: Adult — full access to their own plan

meals.title: What can I cook?
meals.pantryHint: Tick whatever you have. We'll suggest dishes you can actually make.
meals.noneFound: Nothing matched. Try ticking a few more staples.
meals.canCookNow: You can cook this right now
meals.caution: Worth knowing, given {reasons} — go easy on this one.
meals.noProfileNote: Tell us your dietary preferences in your profile and we'll respect them here. Until then these are unfiltered suggestions.
meals.disclaimer: Nutrition figures are rough estimates for orientation, not dietetic advice.
meals.pairWith: Light on protein — serve it with {dish}
meals.customHint: Anything not on the list — your own recipe, a family dish, something you ate out.

dashboard.title: Your week
dashboard.empty: Nothing logged yet. Add a glass of water or tick off a workout and this fills in.
dashboard.waterChartHint: The line is a {litres}L daily goal.
dashboard.workoutChartHint: One bar per day, counting the exercises you ticked off.
dashboard.mealChartHint: Every dish you recorded, from the planner or your own kitchen.
dashboard.footnote: The last seven days, including today. Hover or long-press a bar for its exact figure.

familyDashboard.title: How everyone's doing
familyDashboard.intro: Only what each person has chosen to share with the family appears here.
familyDashboard.notAdmin: This is for the person who set up the family. Ask them to share what you need.
familyDashboard.adherenceCaption: Based on {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} logged
familyDashboard.sharedNote: Sharing {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} with the family.
familyDashboard.footnote: The last seven days. Each person controls what shows up here from their own family settings.
familyDashboard.noPlanYet: No plan yet · logged on {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} this week
